evidence: Current Rust sources read and edited only; no compilation, syntax check, test, GPU call, game/project execution or process inspection

implementation.completion: Ticket.take_completed is nonblocking; returns Uploaded once after the upload fence completes
implementation.emptyFrame: Returns None without recording/submitting GPU commands

resources.vertices: One owned default-heap buffer; 40-byte packet vertex records; per-draw vertex buffer views
resources.indices: One owned default-heap buffer; R32_UINT canonical quad indices; per-draw index buffer views
resources.textures: Owned RGBA8_UNORM default-heap textures plus one white fallback texel
resources.textureConversion: Little-endian ARGB u32 source bytes B,G,R,A become R,G,B,A without premultiplication or color-space conversion
resources.descriptors: One shader-visible SRV heap; slot 0 white, packet texture N uses slot N+1
resources.upload: One owned generic-read upload buffer, capped at 134217728 bytes
resources.footprints: GetCopyableFootprints with zero base offset; validate format/dimensions/rows/row size/pitch/extent before placing each texture at an independently aligned 512-byte offset
resources.padding: Upload allocation initialized before copying; row padding never reads beyond packet pixels

identityAndBounds.queue: Matching device identity, direct list type, one valid node bit with default node zero mapped to heap bit 1
identityAndBounds.input: Recheck draw/texture budgets, attribute and index lengths, quad counts, total vertex/index bytes, dimensions and pixel bytes before GPU allocation
identityAndBounds.nativeWorldJoin: Still required from the rendering owner; this upload API alone does not prove session/frame freshness, native producer scope, camera or world depth

retirement.preSubmissionFailure: Ordinary COM owners and permit guard release preparation allocations; no command list has executed
retirement.submission: All GPU resources, staging buffer, allocator, command list, queue, device and fence enter Ticket before ExecuteCommandLists
retirement.success: Private fence must complete value 1; upload staging owners retire while Uploaded retains draw resources
retirement.deviceRemoval: GetDeviceRemovedReason must report removal before removal cleanup; UINT64_MAX fence sentinel is not success
retirement.abandonment: An unfinished dropped ticket moves into one global retirement slot, retaining the permit and all owners
retirement.signalFailure: Submitted work remains owned even if signaling fails; no unproven completion or timeout release
retirement.reclamation: A later begin call rechecks abandoned fence/device state before allowing another submission
retirement.laterDrawLifetime: The actual draw owner must retain Uploaded until its own draw fence; upload completion is not draw completion

remaining: Native target lease producer for avatar_draw_submit
